newsitem.title: FINLAND: Silja has no estimate on Sea Wind damage.
newsitem.headline: Silja has no estimate on Sea Wind damage.

text.p: SeaWind Line Oy Ab, part of Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy Ab, said on Wednesday its Sea Wind ferry was still grounded off Stockholm and no estimate could yet be given about the size of damages.
"It is impossible to say anything exact about the damage until divers have checked," Sea Wind managing director Soren Lindman told Reuters by telephone.
No one was in danger when the ferry ran aground early on Wednesday, and all 107 passengers had been evacuated to Stockholm, Lindman said.
He could not say how soon it would be possible to move Sea Wind nor how long the ferry would have to be docked for repairs after the accident.
Sea Wind is a so called combi ferry, which carries both cargo and passengers between Turku and Stockholm. It runs about 12 tours per week.
